name: employee-onboarding-progress-tray
title: Employee Onboarding Progress Tray
description: An HR and IT provisioning tracker managing laptop shipping, GitHub team access, and SSO credentialing.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Employee Provisioning Checklist: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
